\title{Converting Markdown to IEEEtran\\ \large A Library for Paper Pipelines}
\author{Petar Djukic\\ \texttt{petar.djukic@example.com}}
\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
Markdown is the source of truth, and the mapping to LaTeX belongs to the
pipeline rather than to a general converter. We state the correspondence
once, in R\&D terms an author can read \cite{du-2023}.
\end{abstract}
\begin{IEEEkeywords}
Markdown, LaTeX, paper pipelines.
\end{IEEEkeywords}
